name: riffle
description: A tray of eight cards. The card under the pointer stands up; the arrow keys walk the cards.
intensity: The ripple spreads further from the pulled card.
tags: cards files browse 卡片 文件 瀏覽

name: terrain
description: Eighty-one pillars on a plinth that rise around the pointer.
tags: landscape field 地形 場域

name: exploded
description: An app window in four layers. Moving across opens the gap; moving down picks a layer.
tags: layers architecture 圖層 架構

name: phosphor
description: A dot matrix that plays a loop, and fades like phosphor where the pointer paints it.
tags: matrix pixels 點陣 軌跡

name: slow
description: Crates riding a belt through a gate. Hovering slows the clock without stopping it.
tags: conveyor pace rate 輸送帶 速度 節奏

name: turntable
description: Blocks on a turntable. A flick spins it; it settles on the nearest quarter turn.
tags: rotate showcase 旋轉 展示

name: keyboard
description: A sixty-key board. The key under the pointer sinks, and its neighbours follow it down.
intensity: A wider patch of keys sinks.
tags: input typing 鍵盤 輸入

name: elevator
description: Four floors beside an open shaft. The pointer's height picks a floor; the car travels there.
intensity: The car travels faster between floors.
tags: floors navigation 樓層 導覽

name: phone
description: A phone in layers: glass, board, battery, shell. Moving across opens the gap; moving down picks a layer.
tags: device layers 手機 圖層

name: laptop
description: A thin laptop, open on its hinge. The pointer's height sets the lid; it follows on a spring.
tags: device open 筆電 開合

name: terminal
description: A terminal window with its history in rows. The pointer's height scrolls back; the line under it lifts and its neighbours follow.
tags: history command 終端 歷史

name: cabinet
description: A rack of twelve blades, a few half out. The pointer's height pulls the nearest ones out, the farther the less.
tags: server rack 伺服器 機櫃

name: branches
description: A commit graph with a branch forking off main and merging back. The commit under the pointer rises, and its history rises after it.
tags: git commit merge 分支 合併

name: vault
description: A vault door with a dial and three bolts. The pointer turns the dial; detents catch every ten, and on the combination the bolts draw back.
tags: safe lock 金庫 鎖

name: lockers
description: A bank of twelve lockers, one ajar at rest. The locker under the pointer opens; the one at rest closes.
tags: storage compartments 置物櫃 收納

name: padlock
description: A padlock with its shackle in. As the pointer comes near the shackle lifts out and swings open.
tags: security access 安全 解鎖

name: patch
description: A patch panel of twenty-four ports with cables. The cable under the pointer lifts and its neighbours lean away.
tags: ports cables 連接 埠

name: dish
description: A parabolic dish on a two-axis gimbal. The pointer aims the dish; it follows on a spring.
tags: signal aim 天線 訊號

name: router
description: A router with its antennas up. Each antenna leans toward the pointer, the nearest most.
tags: network wifi 網路 路由器

name: loupe
description: A stand loupe on a blank ruled sheet. The pointer drags it across; the rules pass enlarged under the glass, with nothing between them.
tags: inspect search 放大 檢視

name: sieve
description: Three test sieves stacked over a pan. The pointer's height picks one; it rises clear of the stack, and every mesh is bare.
tags: filter 篩選 過濾

name: rail
description: A garment rail with seven bare hangers. The pointer brushes them; each rocks away, the nearest most, and settles.
tags: garment hangers 衣架

name: plug
description: A wall socket, and a plug lying on the floor at the end of its cord. The pointer draws the plug up toward the socket; it stops short, and falls back.
intensity: The plug comes closer to the socket.
tags: connection 插頭 連接

name: query
description: A question mark built as a bent bar over a loose ball. The hook turns toward the pointer, and the ball rolls after it.
tags: question help 問題

name: drawer
description: A cabinet of three drawers. The pointer's height picks one; it slides out and shows two dividers with nothing between them.
tags: files storage 文件 抽屜

name: basket
description: A wire basket under a bail handle. It tilts toward the pointer and shows its bare floor; the handle swings after it.
tags: shopping cart 購物 籃子

name: plot
description: A bar chart with seven flat tabs where the bars would stand. The pointer brushes them; each lifts a little and drops back to zero.
tags: chart bars 圖表 長條

name: hub
description: A hub with eight tiles around it on dashed links. The tile under the pointer rises and its link turns solid.
tags: network center 中心 網路

name: relay
description: A hub with four branches of tiles. The path to the leaf under the pointer lights hop by hop.
tags: branch path hops 分支 路徑 傳遞

name: settle
description: Twelve tiles lie crooked round a hub. As the pointer nears it, they slide into a tree and the links draw in.
intensity: The tree forms from further away.
tags: organize consolidate 整理 整合 聚合

name: format
description: A file of ten crooked lines. The pointer runs the formatter down it, and every line above snaps square.
tags: format align document 排版 文件 對齊

name: rebuild
description: A tree of packages. The one under the pointer rises, and every package that depends on it rises after it.
tags: dependencies packages 依賴 套件

name: stack
description: A call stack of five frames. The pointer's height picks one, and the frames above lift away to open it.
tags: frames inspect 堆疊 檢視
